subject.title: feat(gateway): typed structured questions on openclaw.chat with live option cards

question: Should `SystemAgentChatResult.question` become the supported gateway-wide presentation contract for onboarding and wizard choices, rather than a custodian-only UI capability?
rationale: The change is additive and follows the typed-action direction, but it establishes a reusable wire-level client contract whose long-term ownership and compatibility expectations need explicit maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Adopt the typed gateway contract
options.body: Approve the optional field as the shared contract after existing-client compatibility and real web behavior proof are added.

options.title: Keep it custodian-scoped for now
options.body: Avoid exposing the field through the general gateway result until maintainers define the supported multi-client presentation API.

recommendation.title: Adopt the typed gateway contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional field as the shared contract after existing-client compatibility and real web behavior proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature author has the most direct context on the onboarding redesign and proposed gateway contract.
